    StartersAbe Sapien's devilled eggsBoiled eggs with a Dijon, mayo and dill yolk fillingHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp chopped dill1/4 tsp smoked paprika8 dill sprigsBoil the eggs, cool and peel.Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon and dill until smooth.Pipe back into the whites and finish with paprika and a sprig of dill.Bureau red chilli wingsCrisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilliHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 tsp salt30g butter3 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce2 red chillies, finely choppedToss the wings with salt.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Warm the butter with honey, soy sauce and the chopped red chillies until sticky and toss the wings through until glossy.Hellboy's pancake stackYoung Hellboy and his love of pancakesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Small fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with melting butter and maple syrup, with crisp bacon rashers alongside.Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 30g melted butter into a thick batter.Fry 3 tbsp at a time in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, making about 16.Keep warm in a low oven.Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp.Stack the pancakes with butter, pour over maple syrup and serve the bacon on the side.Sloppy joe slidersHellboy's portion.
